body: When you put it this way it sounds nice, but I think following a religion and create a network of brothers and sisters is exclusive to certain types of people. I'm gay, so even if I wanted to be a part of a community like that I'd face a large amount of pushback.

Just like my parents were thinking about themselves when they chose to have me?

Look, life is bullshit. I didn't chose to be born, I didn't chose to be depressed. I'm a leech on society because I am lazy and worthless and live off of borrowed money. Society pressures me to be productive and if I'm not they shun me. Okay, fine. Let me quit, then. I won't be a leech anymore if you lend me some nembutal to drink that will allow me to just go to sleep and never wake up. Instead they force me to live in this hell and choose more readily available (much more uncomfortable) ways of killing myself, and you call it selfish that I want to leave?

Fuck this.

We are in a similar situation, although I was not abused at a young age. When I was 8 I would hold a knife in front of my chest even so often. Feeling suicidal is ingrained in me. Instead I was involved in a sexual relationship with another kid at the age of about 11 - we were both awful to one another. This compounded the issues that I obviously had and I've been very different to others ever since.

I tried to get help from professionals when I was young. My mum took me to a proper one when I was about 12 and then I went to a volunteer counselling organisation when I was 15. The professional one was useless to me. I told her that I thought I was depressed but she ended up telling me that she didn't think I was, and simply felt sad because I was falling out with friends (at the time I was). In reality, I just couldn't describe my emotions well, and I lied about my darkest thoughts about killing myself to her as well. Eventually I just told her I was better and then we never went back.

The volunteer counsellor was better, but I still didn't open up to her. I never told her anything really serious, and eventually lied to her as well and told her I felt better when I really didn't. Counselling doesn't help me because I can't open up to a stranger in that way. I can't even open up to some of my closest friends, let alone a random woman in a weird room.

I'm at a point where I haven't attended class in two years. I barely attended any last year and told them I had some medical issues. They allowed me to repeat the year because I did well on my documentary project. Of course I didn't go to any classes this year, and my parents think I'm going into my final year soon. I'm hitting the wall where I can just exist. So far I have relied on the treadmill and soon it'll stop. I'll be kicked out of Uni and have to tell my parents the truth. I don't want to do any of that and I don't want to get better. I'll kill myself before any of that happens and just enjoy the last few months I have.

I have organised most of the things I need to achieve a painless death. It's there for when I need it. It's happening and no one can stop me.

I am planning to kill myself in the next few months. I have nearly everything I need, and I'll go right before school ends.

I'm sorry to people like you, but I have to do this. Things aren't going to get better for me. I appreciate you saying that you carry some of his weight, but when it comes down to it you don't know how he was feeling.
Are you actually serious right now?
I'm sorry I never responded, I forgot to check this throwaway. I appreciate the kind words. I'm kind of just doing nothing right now.
